CustomField.description: Opens the Workato job that sent this event.
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(Source__c, "Workato"), NOT(ISBLANK(Flow__r.Workato_Recipe_Id__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Workato_Job_Id__c))), HYPERLINK("https://app.trial.workato.com/recipes/" & Flow__r.Workato_Recipe_Id__c & "/job/" & Workato_Job_Id__c, "Open Workato job", "_blank"), "")
CustomField.label: Workato Job Link
